title: Data sources registry
description: External data providers the app pulls from or plans to pull from. Lives at data/sources.json.

sources.description: Each entry must have a unique id.

id.description: Stable machine identifier. Lowercase, snake_case or kebab-case.

refreshCron.description: POSIX cron expression for the refresh schedule.

enabled.description: Whether scheduled refreshes should run. Typically false while status is 'planned'.

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable name that holds the API key. May be empty string when auth is 'none'.

mapping.description: Provider-specific field mapping from the source response to our internal fields. Keys and values are free-form strings.

healthNotes.description: Human-readable operational notes (rate-limit caveats, setup steps, etc.).
